newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm with IPE, region seen balanced.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm with IPE, region seen balanced.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer as IPE crude futures rose, traders said.
Various traders said they saw adequate supplies of material in northwest Europe to cater for existing demand.

One dealer said he saw Skikda and Ras Lanuf potentially available, as well as small quantities of high paraffinic material. Light material was assessed at a premium of around $2 a tonne to full-range barrels, and flat to n+a naphtha.
An ARA end user bought a Russian Dow spec cargo on Tuesday at $188 cif NWE but dealers said this was below the market.
